title: Key West 3-Hour Private Dolphin-Watching Boat Charter
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This three-hour private Key West dolphin safari combines wildlife searching with the flexibility of a private boat charter. Rather than following a fixed group-tour route, your captain adjusts the trip to current conditions and recent wildlife activity. When time and conditions permit, snorkeling, swimming, backcountry sightseeing, or a sandbar stop may be added, but wildlife sightings are never guaranteed.
